title: Hold period suggestion
body:
I suggest making a hold button beside the reset. It is for the situation when I relapse and stay in where I am without taking the decision to get back on track. It means for a single counter there would be two colors: one for the sobriety period, and the other for the relapse. As a sexaholic, this would help me better see my recovery status. I am grateful for this tool.

Best wishes,
Joseph
